fee_notes: Standard Franchise fee is $30,000; Empire Builder Franchise fee is $50,000 (includes 10 Operating Units). If all 10 Empire Builder units open within 3 years, franchisee may enter into 1 additional Standard Franchise for no fee. Eligible Military members and honorably discharged veterans receive a 20% discount. Federally recognized 501(c)(3) organizations also receive a 20% discount. No refunds under any circumstances; no financing offered. Maryland franchisees: all initial fees deferred until franchisor completes pre-opening obligations.
raw_excerpt:
The initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") is $30,000 for a Standard Franchise and $50,000 for an Empire Builder Franchise. If you purchase an Empire Builder Franchise and open and commence operations of all ten (10) Operating Units within three (3) years of the effective date of your franchise agreement, you will have the option to enter into one (1) Standard Franchise for no Initial Franchise Fee.

If you are currently an active or active reserve member of the U.S. Armed Forces, have been honorably discharged from the U.S. Armed Forces ("Eligible Military"), or if the franchisee is a federally recognized 501(c)(3) organization ("501(c)(3)"), you will receive a 20% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee.
